facts.business: RSWM Limited is a textile manufacturing company producing yarn and fabric with operations in India and exports to global markets.

capacity_or_capex.item: Knit business expansion including printing facility
Behind the meter 9.6 MW solar power facility
Power supply agreement with Adani Green Energy Limited and subsidiaries

key_risks: Geopolitical risks including Ukraine-Russia war and US-Iran conflict
High tariffs imposed by USA (50% in August 2026) impacting exports
Operational inefficiency in spinning division at Chhata units
Non-viability of planned capex in Jammu & Kashmir
facts.related_party_note: Power supply agreement with Adani Green Energy Limited, Adani Energy Solutions and their subsidiaries under group captive scheme; subscription of instruments worth Rs 60 crore.
